The task is to update the settings so that when the selected screen is Cassette, the cassette variant controls show up right below the screen setting. I'm noting that there’s a Settings UI found in `lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart`, so I’ll need to inspect that file and see how everything is structured.
